name: Default
shortDescription: Rust web server and reverse proxy that serves a static site from a persistent volume, configured through an editable KDL file.

alerts.message: Ferron serves its welcome page until you replace the files in the ferron-www volume (/var/www/ferron) or edit ferron.kdl. Keep the :80 host block: HTTPS is handled in front of the container, so Ferron's automatic TLS stays off.
